firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently saw one of the game’s wildlife starts. The rulebook also explicitly allows choosing the starting player randomly.
officialTieBreak: No separate tie-break is stated; random selection is an official alternative.
clarifications: Choosing randomly is part of the printed setup, not an added house rule.
internalEvidence: AEG’s Cascadia page links this PDF. It is image-based, so setup pages 4 and 5 were rendered and visually read. Step 8 gives wildlife observation or random selection; page 5 says clockwise.
uncertainty: The source does not define whether a sighting must be in person. The URL’s 2025 upload path is not treated as an edition date.
